description: As the tested service provider, dispute a funded field-test result claim only when the stated run did not take place. Available within 72 hours of submission while no confirmation is recorded. A dispute moves the claim to manual review; it does not delete the tester result. Disagreeing with a failed outcome is not grounds for a dispute. No money is transferred.
